jobDescription:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Associate Client Engagement Manager works alongside the senior Client Engagement Manager to drive Celebal's commercial and client engagement activity across the GCC primarily Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with a clear path to owning accounts and transactions outright.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, but it is not a coordination role. You will be expected to hold your own in a first conversation with a Microsoft solution specialist or a client stakeholder without a technical colleague on the call, to explain what Celebal does differently in a specific solution area, and to build and defend a commercial estimate. Pre-sales, delivery and practice teams support you; they do not substitute for you.

Read this before applying: the interview includes a live technical and commercial assessment. Candidates who position themselves as functional or relationship-only sellers, and who require pre-sales support for every solution conversation, are not a fit for this role — regardless of years of experience or account pedigree.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Pipeline Ownership & Deal Progression

  • Own and progress a defined slice of the GCC opportunity pipeline — from qualification through proposal submission, negotiation support and closure — with the senior CEM as escalation point rather than as approver of every step.
  • Run RFP, RFI and tender responses end to end: interpret requirements, decompose the scope, own the response plan and timeline, drive contributions from pre-sales and practice leads, and assemble a submission that is compliant and commercially sound.
  • Manage Microsoft and partner co-sell motions directly — deal registration, co-sell submissions, MCI/ECIF and pre-sales funding nominations, and joint account planning with Microsoft SSPs, ATUs and partner leads (Crayon and others).
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy and pipeline reporting to a standard that leadership can act on without rework.
  • Schedule and lead client meetings, demos and technical presentations; author the meeting narrative and the follow-up MOM, not just the logistics.

2. Client Engagement & Account Ownership

  • Act as a named point of contact for assigned accounts, holding day-to-day commercial and delivery-liaison conversations independently.
  • Produce client-facing material — proposals, BoQ and BoM summaries, executive briefings, project status narratives — in a form that goes to the client with light review, not heavy rewriting.
  • Track milestone status with delivery, trigger milestone-linked commercial actions, and own invoicing follow-up, collections escalation and revenue realisation for your accounts.
  • Maintain complete, auditable engagement documentation: MSAs, SOWs, Change Requests, LOIs, correspondence and approval trails.

3. Solution Positioning & Differentiation

  • Articulate what Celebal does differently in specific solution areas — Microsoft Fabric and Databricks-based data platform modernisation, migration accelerators, GenAI and agentic use cases, sovereign cloud and security — and why that beats an incumbent system integrator. This is a core competency of the role, not a marketing hand-off.
  • Maintain and actively use the GCC solution narrative: capability decks, reference architectures, case studies, industry-specific use-case libraries and competitive positioning.
  • Translate a client problem statement into an indicative solution shape and commercial envelope in the room, then validate it with pre-sales — rather than deferring the entire conversation.

4. Proposal, Estimation & Commercial Construction

  • Author the executive summary, scope of work, assumptions, exclusions and commercial sections of proposals; source tech stack, effort estimates and delivery timelines from pre-sales and delivery and integrate them coherently.
  • Build and adjust Azure consumption estimates independently using the Azure pricing calculator — storage, compute, capacity SKUs and licensing — and understand how those choices move the client's total cost.
  • Draft quotations, SOW summaries and Change Request documentation; understand the difference between T&M, fixed-price, managed-capacity and outcome-based structures and when each is appropriate.

5. Internal Coordination & Governance

  • Liaise with delivery, legal, finance and HR on engagement onboarding, commercial issue resolution and contract execution.
  • Prepare internal briefing notes, commercial summaries, deal review packs and escalation memos of a standard suitable for regional leadership review.
  • Contribute to WBS updates, revenue forecasting and weekly/monthly business reviews.
  • Ensure clean account handovers with full context and documentation captured.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Essential — screened against, no exceptions

  • GCC market experience. 4–6 years in B2B technology sales, client engagement, pre-sales or account management, including demonstrable UAE and/or KSA market experience — in-market work history, or documented ownership of GCC-based client relationships. Regional exposure gained purely through remote channel coordination does not meet this requirement.
  • Microsoft partner ecosystem depth. Hands-on experience with co-sell motions, deal registration, and pre-sales or partner funding mechanisms (MCI, ECIF or equivalent), including working relationships with Microsoft field roles (SSP, ATU, partner development).
  • Data & AI portfolio literacy. Working knowledge of the Microsoft data and AI stack — Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, GenAI/Copilot patterns — sufficient to scope a data platform, migration or AI use-case conversation unaided.
  • Cloud and security fundamentals. Practical fluency in Azure architecture basics, M365/O365, and Microsoft security and compliance (Sentinel, Defender, identity). Certification at fundamentals level or above (AZ-900, MS-900, SC-900, DP-900 or higher) is expected; equivalent demonstrated knowledge is acceptable.
  • Estimation capability. Able to build and defend an Azure consumption estimate on the Azure pricing calculator without pre-sales assistance. This is tested live during interview.
  • RFP and tender ownership. Direct experience running or substantially owning RFP, RFI or government tender responses, including compliance and commercial sections.
  • Services-commercial exposure. Familiarity with MSAs, SOWs and Change Requests, and with authoring scope and commercial terms for services engagements — as distinct from licensing or product resale.
  • Deal scale. Experience on engagements where individual proof-of-concept values reach USD 150K or above and multi-year programmes exceed USD 1M. Celebal proof-of-concept engagements alone routinely run USD 200K–250K.
  • Applied AI fluency. Uses AI tooling deliberately in the sales craft — research, account intelligence, first-draft proposal and RFP response construction, competitive analysis — with judgement about what must still be authored and verified by a human.
  • Communication. Clear, professional written and spoken English; able to produce client-ready correspondence and documents with minimal supervision.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. MBA or a technical postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  • Mobility. Based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, with a valid ability to travel across KSA and the GCC.

Preferred

  • Arabic language capability.
  • Prior employment with a Microsoft partner, system integrator or technology consulting firm serving enterprise clients in the region.
  • Account experience in logistics, government or public sector, FMCG, or financial services in the GCC.
  • Exposure to sovereign cloud, data residency or regional compliance requirements (SDAIA, NDMO, UAE data protection).
  • Experience with CRM and revenue tooling — Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clari.
  • Familiarity with government procurement portals and tender platforms in KSA or the UAE.

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical credibility. Can hold a solution conversation with an architect or Microsoft specialist and be taken seriously. This is the single most important competency in the role.
  • Commercial judgement. Understands deal structures, pricing models, margin implications and revenue recognition well enough to shape a deal, not just document it.
  • Independent ownership. Moves an opportunity forward without waiting to be told the next step; escalates with a recommendation attached.
  • Competitive framing. Can explain why Celebal, in a specific solution area, against a specific incumbent, in under two minutes.
  • Organisational rigour. Manages concurrent engagements with accurate documentation, clean CRM and reliable follow-through.
  • Stakeholder navigation. Comfortable across pre-sales, delivery, legal and finance internally, and across client procurement, IT and business stakeholders externally.
  • Cross-cultural effectiveness. Operates credibly in GCC business culture and with distributed India-based delivery teams.
  • Adaptability. Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth regional business with evolving priorities.

SELECTION PROCESS

Candidates should expect a structured assessment rather than a conversational interview. The process comprises an HR screening, a technical and commercial round with sales leadership, and a regional fit discussion.

What we assess


How

Solution positioning


You will be asked to pitch Celebal cold to a Microsoft SSP covering a named industry, and to answer why a client should move work to us from an incumbent SI. Generic value statements do not clear this stage.

Commercial sizing


You will be asked to open the Azure pricing calculator on screen and build or adjust a simple estimate — storage, compute, capacity SKU — without pre-sales support.

Solution depth


You will be asked to walk through the most technically complex engagement you have sold, including data sources, integration approach and platform choices, in your own words.

Commercial structure


You will be asked how a proposal is assembled — which sections you author, which you source from pre-sales and delivery, and how pricing model and timelines are arrived at.


CAREER PATH

This role is a structured route into a full Client Engagement Manager position. Candidates who demonstrate technical credibility, commercial judgement and independent account ownership will be considered for progression within 18–24 months. Progression is assessed on independent deal ownership and solution credibility, not tenure.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
  • Direct exposure to marquee enterprise and government accounts across the GCC.
  • Close collaboration with Microsoft field and product teams, including global initiative and sovereign cloud programmes.

title: AEO & GEO Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Spring Health is looking for an AEO GEO Lead to own how our brand and content perform across AI-powered search and discovery. This role will span both our B2B and direct-to-consumer businesses, with responsibility for improving how Spring Health is found, understood and cited by the platforms people increasingly use to research, compare and make decisions.

This is a technical, hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn AEO and GEO into an operating system. You ll build and run the experimentation engine, test what improves crawlability, retrieval, visibility and citation, ship changes quickly and use the results to decide what to scale. You ll work across web, data and technical teams to make sure Spring Health s digital presence is structured to perform as AI discovery continues to evolve, and youll connect that performance to traffic, demand and pipeline. You ll own the process end to end. Sometimes that means creating content yourself. Other times it means using AI, briefing a freelancer, working with an internal expert or partnering with web and engineering. The goal is figuring out what gets Spring Health discovered and cited, then building a repeatable system around it. Reporting to the Senior Director, B2B Content and Communications, this is a full time, fully remote position on our team. Occasional travel may be required for team or company events/meetings.

What you ll be doing

  • Build and own Spring Health s company-wide AEO and GEO strategy, spanning both B2B employer and D2C member audiences.
  • Test content, page structures, formats, sources, authorship signals and technical changes to understand what actually drives AI visibility and citation.
  • Monitor how major AI and search platforms crawl, index, retrieve and cite Spring Health information.
  • Partner with Web and Engineering to address technical barriers and improve structured data, schema, semantic HTML, internal linking, site architecture and crawlability.
  • Own onsite/offsite content as discovery and experimentation surfaces.
  • Extend visibility strategies across relevant third-party platforms and communities that influence AI-powered discovery and brand authority.
  • Maximize the long-term discovery value of high-priority content and thought leadership.
  • Ensure AEO and GEO standards are consistently applied across Spring Health's broader digital content ecosystem.
  • Build and own the AEO scorecard. Connect AI discovery performance to traffic, demand and pipeline impact.
  • Use AI and automation extensively to accelerate research, content development, testing, monitoring and analysis.
  • Serve as the company-wide expert on AEO and AI discovery as the space continues to change.
  • You ll work across communications, marketing, web and other teams to turn Spring Health s expertise into content that AI engines can find, understand and cite. You ll have AI tools and flexible creative resources to help you move quickly, while you stay focused on the strategy, experimentation and technical work that drives AI visibility.

What success looks like in this role

  • Improve Spring Health s visibility and citation across priority AI-powered search and answer platforms for B2B and consumer.
  • Increase qualified website traffic and engagement from AI-powered search and discovery channels.
  • Launch and evaluate a consistent pipeline of AEO and GEO experiments, using results to determine what approaches should be scaled.
  • Improve the technical readiness of priority web content for crawling, retrieval and citation, including structured data, site architecture and content structure.
  • Demonstrate measurable contribution from AI search and discovery efforts to business outcomes such as leads, opportunities and pipeline.

What you ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in technical SEO or search visibility, with full-time focus on AEO and GEO in recent years.
  • Hands-on experience improving visibility across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity or Google AI experiences.
  • A strong understanding of how search engines and LLM-based systems crawl, index, retrieve and cite web content.
  • Technical fluency with structured data, schema/JSON-LD, semantic HTML, site architecture, rendering, canonicalization, internal linking and indexing.
  • A strong experimentation mindset. You form a hypothesis, get something live, inspect what happened and make the next decision from the evidence.
  • Experience with Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and AI visibility platforms.
  • The ability to create and modify content when needed without relying on a traditional editorial production process.
  • Strong AI fluency and experience using automation to accelerate research, creation, testing and analysis.
  • The ability to brief and manage freelancers and internal subject matter experts to get work shipped quickly.
  • Strong analytical judgment. The measurement in this space is still developing, and you need to be comfortable deciding what is signal and what is noise.
  • The ability to work effectively with Web, Engineering, Data, Marketing and Communications teams.
  • A track record of building new capabilities without waiting for someone else to hand you the playbook.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect search and AI visibility performance to pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Nice to have

  • Experience with server logs or crawler analysis
  • Basic HTML/CSS, Python or SQL, APIs and automated workflows
  • Experience with proprietary research, or healthcare and other regulated categories.
  • In-house B2B or B2B SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

This role sits within CLOUDSUFI s live engagement where AI is already embedded operationally across reliability and platform engineering-not a future aspiration. The team runs an AI SRE co-pilot that reasons across observability, cloud, and ticketing platforms; a set of purpose-built AI sub-agents for incident triage, monitor hygiene, and usage/cost attribution; and a formal AI governance program that assesses CLOUDSUFI s own internal AI agents for risk before they touch production. You will be embedded with the client s SRE function supporting a regulated consumer-lending platform on AWS-hundreds of microservices, event-driven pipelines, and customer-facing loan origination and servicing journeys where reliability is directly a customer-trust and compliance concern. As a Junior SRE Engineer, you will work under the guidance of senior engineers and architects to support, operate, and learn from this AI-driven reliability program.
Responsibilities - AI-Driven Initiatives

1. AI-Augmented Incident Response Root Cause Analysis
  • Support incident response as a shadow or secondary responder, using AI-driven detection, correlation, and root-cause analysis tooling under the guidance of senior engineers to speed up triage.
  • Help assemble incident timelines from metrics, logs, traces, and deploy history, learning to separate the alert that fired from the change that actually caused it.
  • Help operate and monitor the existing AI SRE sub-agents (covering areas such as incident summarization, monitor-gap detection, and usage attribution), flagging anomalies or failures for senior review.
  • Assist in documenting AI-assisted incident findings and postmortems, including tracking corrective and preventive actions through to closure.

2. AI-Driven Observability Alert Quality
  • Build and maintain monitors, dashboards, and SLO definitions in Datadog as code via Terraform , rather than clicking through the UI.
  • Assist in reducing alert noise using AI/ML-assisted detection (anomaly, outlier, and forecast monitors, composite conditions, and dynamic thresholds) so that pages stay actionable and rare.
  • Run recurring monitor-hygiene and coverage-gap reviews - no-data monitors, missing no-data notification, orphaned monitors on decommissioned services, and monitors with no owning team tag or valid notification target.
  • Support SLI/SLO and error-budget reviews for critical customer journeys, escalating services trending toward budget exhaustion to senior team members.

3. AI-Enabled Cloud Reliability, Capacity Cost Engineering
  • Support day-to-day reliability of AWS workloads - ECS/Fargate, EKS, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, ALB, SQS/SNS and Step Functions - under senior guidance.
  • Use predictive analytics and intelligent monitoring dashboards to spot capacity, saturation, and cost anomalies across host, container, log, APM, and serverless usage, escalating notable trends with evidence.
  • Assist in observability and cloud cost governance , attributing spend and telemetry volume to owning teams and services and helping identify low-value, high-cost signals.

4. AI Governance, Risk Reliability Reviews (Learning Track)
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews, learning how reliability risk and AI-agent risk (e.g., prompt injection, authorization gaps, secrets exposure in agent and tool configuration, blast radius of autonomous actions) is assessed and documented.
  • Learn how production-readiness, change management, and audit expectations apply in a regulated environment (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, SOX, GLBA), and why observability evidence matters to auditors.
  • Assist in tracking action items from the AI-risk and reliability remediation roadmap and help prepare status updates for stakeholders.

5. AI-Enabled DevOps, CI/CD Automation
  • Support the implementation of reliability and safety controls within CI/CD pipelines , learning automation-first and AI-augmented approaches and shift-left practices from senior engineers.
  • Help integrate AI-assisted checks (e.g., change-risk summaries, infrastructure drift detection, dependency and configuration checks) into the delivery lifecycle.
  • Write and maintain automation in Python and Bash against platform APIs (Datadog, AWS, GitHub, PagerDuty, Jira) to replace recurring manual work, and contribute Terraform modules and pull requests under review.
  • Assist with runbook creation and the progressive automation of runbook steps toward self-healing.

6. AI-Enabled Program Workflow Support
  • Support multiple concurrent reliability initiatives using AI-enabled workflow and tracking tools shared across SRE and Security teams.
  • Help promote a reliability-first culture by learning and sharing data-driven, AI-backed operational practices with the wider team.

SRE Cloud Capabilities
  • Interest in observability and monitoring fundamentals - metrics, logs, traces, and APM - and a willingness to learn predictive analytics and anomaly detection.
  • Exposure to at least one observability platform (Datadog preferred; Grafana/Prometheus, New Relic, CloudWatch, or ELK/OpenSearch also relevant).
  • Foundational understanding of SLI, SLO, and error-budget concepts, and of why alert fatigue is a reliability problem rather than an annoyance.
  • Hands-on exposure to AWS (or an equivalent hyperscaler) across compute, networking, storage, and managed database services, with interest in automated reliability tooling.

  • Basic Linux troubleshooting and networking fundamentals, including DNS, TLS, load balancing, timeouts and retries.
  • Some hands-on exposure to automation or scripting (Python, Bash, or similar), including consuming REST APIs and parsing JSON.
  • Comfort with Git and pull-request-based workflows, and exposure to CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD or similar).
  • Familiarity with incident management and on-call concepts, including severity models, escalation policies, and paging tools such as PagerDuty or Opsgenie.
  • Basic exposure to cloud posture and continuous monitoring concepts, and to change and release management discipline.
  • Practical curiosity about LLM-based assistants and agents applied to operations, and about how to verify whether their output is actually correct.
About You

  • Some exposure to cloud-native logging and monitoring tools, and interest in AI-driven alerting and noise reduction.

title: AI Automation & Technology Manager
tagsAndSkills: Project Management,Project Development,IT Project Management,IT Projects,Project Monitoring,Project Tracking,Software Project,Project Delivery
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Teachwell Institute & Teachwell Overseas is looking for a hands-on AI Automation & Technology Manager to become the company's first dedicated technology resource and help us build an AI-enabled education and counselling ecosystem.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding existing business processes, identifying opportunities for automation and building practical technology solutions using AI, APIs, Google Workspace, workflow automation and web technologies.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional IT support role.

The candidate will work directly with the management team to convert manual processes into automated digital workflows, dashboards and internal tools.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. AI & Business Process Automation

  • Study existing business processes across counselling, admissions, test preparation, study abroad, marketing and operations.
  • Identify repetitive manual tasks that can be automated using AI and workflow automation.
  • Design and implement automated workflows.
  • Integrate AI tools with internal business processes.
  • Build AI-assisted systems for counselling, reporting, lead management and student operations.
  • Reduce dependency on manual data entry and repetitive ChatGPT prompting.

2. Google Forms Sheets AI Dashboard

A major responsibility will be converting existing Google Form-based processes into structured technology workflows.

The candidate should be able to build systems such as:

Google Form Google Sheet Data Processing AI Analysis Report Counsellor Dashboard Parent/Student Output

The candidate will:

  • Build and maintain Google Forms.
  • Structure Google Sheets as databases/data sources.
  • Develop Google Apps Script automations.
  • Connect Google Workspace with external APIs.
  • Automate report generation.
  • Create dashboards and internal interfaces.
  • Develop systems that can eventually replace manual spreadsheet-based workflows.

3. AI APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT

The candidate should have experience working with modern AI tools and APIs.

Responsibilities may include:

  • OpenAI APIs
  • Claude APIs
  • Gemini APIs
  • AI agents
  • LLM workflows
  • Prompt engineering
  • Structured JSON outputs
  • Retrieval/database-based AI systems
  • AI-powered report generation
  • AI-powered counselling assistants
  • AI-based internal tools

The candidate should understand that AI should be integrated into real business workflows, not merely used for content generation.

4. WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT & MAINTENANCE

Teachwell currently has a Node.js-based website/application ecosystem, and we want to reduce dependency on external developers for routine changes.

The candidate will:

  • Maintain existing Node.js applications.
  • Make minor website/application changes independently.
  • Fix bugs and troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Add new pages, forms and functionality.
  • Integrate APIs and third-party services.
  • Maintain website performance and security.
  • Manage Git/GitHub repositories and deployment workflows.
  • Coordinate with external developers when specialised support is required.

Node.js experience is therefore highly desirable.

5. INTERNAL DASHBOARD DEVELOPMENT

The candidate will gradually help Teachwell move from spreadsheets and disconnected tools towards an integrated internal dashboard.

Potential modules may include:

  • Student database
  • Lead management
  • Counselling dashboard
  • Application tracking
  • University database
  • Student profile management
  • Admission Saathi dashboard
  • Test preparation leads
  • Study abroad applications
  • Counsellor task management
  • Application deadlines
  • Reports and analytics
  • AI-generated recommendations

The candidate will work with management to define requirements and convert them into practical technology solutions.

6. API & SYSTEM INTEGRATIONS

The candidate should be comfortable connecting different platforms through APIs.

Examples include:

Google Forms
Google Sheets
Google Drive
CRM
WhatsApp
Email
AI APIs
Website
Database
Dashboard

Responsibilities:

  • API integration
  • Webhooks
  • Authentication
  • Data transfer
  • Error handling
  • Automation triggers
  • Third-party integrations

7. CRM & LEAD AUTOMATION

Teachwell uses CRM-based workflows for managing leads and student enquiries.

The candidate will work with the operations and counselling teams to:

  • Automate lead movement.
  • Create automated notifications.
  • Connect forms with CRM.
  • Automate counsellor assignments.
  • Build follow-up workflows.
  • Integrate CRM with AI tools.
  • Create management dashboards.
  • Reduce duplicate data entry.

8. DATA & DATABASE MANAGEMENT

The candidate should understand basic database architecture and data structures.

Preferred knowledge:

  • PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB
  • Database design
  • Data relationships
  • JSON
  • REST APIs
  • Data validation
  • Authentication
  • Basic security practices

The candidate should be able to design data structures that can scale as Teachwell's student database grows.

9. DOCUMENTATION & SYSTEM OWNERSHIP

Since this will initially be a one-person technology function, the candidate must document everything they build.

Responsibilities include:

  • Maintain technical documentation.
  • Maintain API documentation.
  • Maintain workflow diagrams.
  • Maintain database documentation.
  • Maintain deployment information.
  • Maintain Git repositories.
  • Create SOPs for internal technology processes.
  • Ensure the company does not become dependent on one external developer.

10. WORK DIRECTLY WITH MANAGEMENT

This position will work closely with the Founder/Management.

The candidate should be comfortable receiving a requirement such as:

"Currently my counsellor fills this Google Form. Then she copies the information into ChatGPT, researches universities and prepares a report. I want this entire process automated."

The candidate should be able to:

Understand Analyse Design Build Test Deploy Improve

without requiring a detailed technical specification for every small task.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

Experience

25 years of experience in one or more of:

  • Full Stack Development
  • AI Automation
  • SaaS Product Development
  • Workflow Automation
  • AI Application Development
  • Startup Technology
  • EdTech Technology
  • Business Process Automation
